source_title: Bose’s new Lifestyle Ultra Speaker falls to a record low
source_excerpt:

Good sound can make a living room feel a lot more inviting, especially when you want one speaker that handles music on its own but can also grow into a bigger setup later. That’s what makes this deal worth a look, because the Bose New Lifestyle Ultra Speaker is down to $279 on Amazon right now.
That price is $70 off the $349 recommended retail price, which is a 20% discount. Better yet, this is an all-time low price for the speaker, so it’s a strong time to buy if it’s already been on your list.
The Lifestyle Ultra Speaker is a compact premium wireless home speaker from Bose’s revived Lifestyle lineup. It supports Wi-Fi streaming with Apple AirPlay, Google Cast, and Spotify Connect, and it also includes Bluetooth 5.3. You can control it through the Bose app, and it can work in a few different ways depending on what you need.
On its own, it’s built for casual home listening with sound that’s described as big, room-filling, and detailed for its size. If you want audio in more than one room, it can join multi-room groups. It can also become part of a larger Bose home setup with the matching Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and Subwoofer, which gives it more room to fit into a TV or movie setup later.
Bose also gives it a more furniture-friendly look than a lot of boxy tech gear, so it should blend into a room more easily. For anyone after a compact speaker with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and a path to a bigger system, this Amazon deal looks like a very good one.
